caveats: Archive study exported from the native Revit model (LOD 200 overall, LOD 300 facades); geometry is scaled, transferred or inferred from archive sources, not a measured survey.
One Revit element is one registered product; its material parts are the components. Revit sub-elements (balusters, top rails, nested trims) are separate products linked to their host by parentId.
Provenance (VM_Method, VM_Confidence, tolerances, LOD, licence) is copied from the VM Heritage shared parameters; open QS findings stay listed in VM_Findings.
Room references come from Revit rooms of the villa (doors and windows: from/to room; other family instances: room at the element centre). Walls, slabs and roofs carry no room reference.
Storey elevations follow the Revit levels (P3 = 0.00, P1 at -7.55 m per D3); the vertical tie P3 = 68.55 +/- 0.30 m CTRN 2002 is provisional (VM-D064).
No host/filling opening records are registered in V14 (openings list empty); door and window host walls are listed in the element properties where known.
Portineria, gate, Dependance, site and context are delivered in the surroundings model and are not registered products.
